title: Quarterly private deploy roll-forward testing lanes & commitment funnel
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Define and instrument a set of 'roll-forward testing lanes' for Quarterly private/VPC/on-prem releases. Goal: reduce manual rollback windows and shorten customer-visible outage surface by enabling automated roll-forward fixes, targeted canaries, and a commitment funnel that gates tranche progression. Deliverables include test harness definitions, synthetic traffic profiles per cohort, gating signal thresholds, operational runbook text, and a minimized set of blocking compatibility checks for early waves.
acceptance_criteria: A1: Automated synthetic harness can run per-tenant for 3 cohort profiles and generate pass/fail signals
A2: Commitment funnel with 4 tranche gates defined and documented in Confluence with acceptance thresholds
A3: Runbook includes explicit roll-forward steps for at least 3 common failure modes and is validated by SRE tabletop
A4: Two pilot customers complete a staged rollout using lanes with <10% increase in incident pages vs baseline
A5: Telemetry queries (dashboards) available for SLO burn and rollback indicator within Console
